feedback.suspended: Click anywhere on the page once to activate the boost.
feedback.no_media: No playing audio found on this page yet. Start playback and it will kick in automatically.
feedback.blocked_drm: This content is DRM-protected (e.g. Netflix), so its audio can't be boosted. Playback is unaffected.
feedback.blocked_cors: This site's audio is served from another source without permission to process it, so it can't be boosted.
feedback.partial: This page also has an audio source that can't be boosted (DRM-protected or cross-origin) — lowering the volume still works, but boosting above 100% won't affect it.
feedback.attach_failed: Couldn't hook into this page's audio — boosting above 100% is unavailable for now (lowering still works). Refresh the page and try again.
popup.permRequired: A one-time permission is needed to process this tab's audio.
